info.name: SAT Datashare localhost
info.description:
Localhost GETs. Run one app at a time on 8081, or change exp_base / papi_base / sapi_base if ports differ.
Exp: fromDate, toDate, pageNumber only.
PAPI/SAPI: also database=sat_nobleoutlook and supplier.
